title: Comic Book Generator Demo
overview: A demonstration of the Comic Serial app, which generates multi-frame comic books from text prompts using AI models (Gemini). The video walks through entering a prompt, selecting models, generating a comic book with character references and multiple pages, rendering it to HTML, and previewing the final result.
